title: Count vowels
prompt: Return how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in text, ignoring capitalization. An empty string has 0 vowels.

defects.note: count = 0 is inside the loop, so it resets on every character and the result is only ever 0 or 1 (and an empty string crashes). Move it above the loop.
Checking membership in a string is correct Python: 'e' in "aeiou" is True.
